standard_prerequisites.name: The algebraic statement that a surjective endomorphism of a finite free module of fixed rank is an isomorphism

standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades the surjectivity of the map on sections to injectivity, which is what remains to be shown.

core_obligations: Local trivialisation: at a point the proof chooses a neighbourhood on which both modules are free of the same rank (proof lines 2374-2377)

Split the surjection: lifts of the free generators of the target along the surjection give a map back whose composite with the given map is the identity, so the map on sections over that neighbourhood is surjective (proof lines 2378-2383)

Conclude injectivity: since both modules of sections are finite free modules of the same rank over the ring of functions, the algebraic statement upgrades surjectivity to injectivity, and the local trivialisations being of the same rank everywhere finishes the proof (proof lines 2383-2389)
proof_roadmap: 设 φ 满，取 x ∈ X 与其邻域 U 使 F|_U ≅ G|_U ≅ O_U^{⊕r}；把 G|_U 的自由生成元沿 φ 提升，得 ψ : G|_U → F|_U 使 φ|_U ∘ ψ = id，从而 Γ(U,F) → Γ(U,G) 满。
因 Γ(U,F) 与 Γ(U,G) 都同构于 Γ(U,O_U)^{⊕r}，由「有限自由模上满自同态是同构」的跨章引理得该映射单，故 φ|_U 是同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a map between finite locally free modules of the same rank is an isomorphism exactly when it is surjective (author lemma at source lines 2364-2371, label lemma-map-finite-locally-free). The proof (source lines 2373-2390) trivialises both modules on a neighbourhood of a point, lifts the free generators of the target to obtain a splitting of the surjection, and then applies the algebraic fact that a surjective endomorphism of a finite free module of fixed rank is injective to the induced map on sections (proof lines 2383-2389). The splitting together with the reduction to modules over the ring of sections is the content. H2.
